method: Manual visual inspection of UI Bowl's rendered enlarged frames through the browser; no live source-product interactions.

sampling.strategy: Bounded task-based comparison using visible current-popularity links, dashboard/comparison filters, and one contrasting mobile product.
sampling.claim: Distinct observed frame IDs, not independent design directions, full pages, or a complete product flow.
